svg.text: What each place on a face shows now, and what it could show instead. A sound card's face (it has every place), 3.6 times its size.
· The device's name in capitals, cut with “…” where it doesn't fit (160

· A name of your own (renamed in Patchcord)

KIND · small print under the name
· A device: its API · bus, its form if not built in: ALSA · PCI, ALSA ·

with nothing to show: NO INPUTS OR OUTPUTS

· Anything else: MIDI, STEREO or MONO

· No key: in a right-click menu
· Green: running, amber: idle, dark: suspended

· Flickering with the sound, as a signal LED
